# AMD/Xilinx Vivado EDA Plugin: features

Run with `invoke_plugin_feature(feature_id, plugin_id="vivado", args={...})`. Prefer these over clicking: they use hotkeys and menus the plugin already knows.

| Feature | What it does | Hotkey | Menu | Pane | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vivado.launch_simulation` | Triggers behavioral simulation compile/elaboration via Tcl console or Flow Navigator |  |  | flow_navigator |  |
| `vivado.zoom_fit` | Focuses the waveform canvas and presses 'F' to fit the full simulation timeline into the view | f |  | waveform_canvas |  |
| `vivado.zoom_in` | Zooms in horizontally on the waveform timeline | ctrl+= |  | waveform_canvas |  |
| `vivado.zoom_out` | Zooms out horizontally on the waveform timeline | ctrl+- |  | waveform_canvas |  |
| `vivado.run_all` | Runs simulation indefinitely until $finish or $stop breakpoint | f5 |  | workspace |  |
| `vivado.run_for` | Steps simulation forward by a designated time duration (e.g. '500ns', '10us') | shift+f2 |  | tcl_console | `time` |
| `vivado.restart` | Resets simulation time to 0 ns while preserving waveform configuration | ctrl+shift+f5 |  | workspace |  |
| `vivado.add_wave` | Adds design hierarchy or signal path to active waveform viewer |  |  | tcl_console | `signal` |
| `vivado.set_radix` | Configures display radix (hex, bin, dec, ascii, unsigned) for waveform signals |  |  | tcl_console | `radix`, `signals` |
| `vivado.tcl_exec` | Dispatches deterministic Tcl command string to the Vivado Tcl Console |  |  | tcl_console | `command` |
| `vivado.toggle_flow_navigator` | Toggles or collapses the left Flow Navigator panel to reclaim horizontal workspace for waveforms | ctrl+q |  | flow_navigator |  |

Named panes for `capture_pane(pane_name)`: `flow_navigator`, `scope_objects`, `tcl_console`, `waveform_canvas`, `workspace`.
